text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, chorizo!
choice_data_list: That's an unusual greeting, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, I let my excitement get ahead of 
me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, did you know about the new fast 
food item!?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Its name is... the Super Spicy Mega-Loaded 
Chorizo Burger!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Packed with ultra spicy chorizo, you say?! 
Well, we simply have no choice but to go 
eat it!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This is definitely gonna be delicious, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer! Let's go grab something 
to eat together~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Isn't that Hishi Ama-senpai over 
there?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, if it isn't El.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aha, don't tell me you guys came to try 
out the new release too?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
CORREEEECT! When I hear "super spicy," I 
simply can't ignore it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It didn't taste bad, but it wasn't 
really that spicy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"As for the spiciness, I'd say it's just 
so-so. It might not live up to your 
expectations."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Is that so!? That is truly unfortunate...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
However! Fufufu... El never leaves 
anything to chance!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I anticipated just such an occasion, so I 
brought along El's Special Sauce!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Red-hot bottled salsa roja! Packed with 
plenty of chili peppers, yeeees!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I'm intrigued. If you don't mind, 
would you let me taste just the sauce?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Of course, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to try some too, Trainer?! 
It's El's pride and joy: blazing Salsa 
Roja!
choice_data_list: Looks like we can work up a good sweat.
Looks like we can work up a good sweat.
It has a powerful ring to it.
It has a powerful ring to it, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to try some too, Trainer?! 
It's El's pride and joy: blazing Salsa 
Roja!
choice_data_list: Looks like we can work up a good sweat.
Looks like we can work up a good sweat.
It has a powerful ring to it.
It has a powerful ring to it, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
There is no doubt about that! My tongue 
tingles, the sweat pours, it is the best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
T-To that extent...? Surely that's going a 
bit—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This will boost my metabolism, and with 
some nutrition from the chorizo, my 
stamina will be in top shape!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, we can't bring outside food into the 
shop, so let's eat in the park! Excuse 
me~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, starting with the sauce! This is El's 
special homemade sauce!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Gwah!? J-Just the smell is making my eyes 
burn, my eyes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come now, don't be shy! Go ahead and say 
'aah'!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Eek!? W-Wait a sec...! Aaaaaaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! It's so exciting to taste the 
strongest flavor! Here, Trainer, you have 
some too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An indescribable pain shoots from my mouth 
and races across my entire body at 
breakneck speed...! W-What is this—?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Are you two okay...? You started shaking 
out of nowhere and totally startled me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm the one who's surprised here... 
Ow, my mouth and lips hurt..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After soothing my mouth with a drink, I 
ate the super spicy chorizo burger. 
...Curiously, it almost tasted sweet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa slathered on plenty of her 
special sauce, happily savoring the fiery 
spice...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Salsa" means "sauce," and "roja" means 
"red", you seeeeee!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Red is the color of passion! It wouldn't 
be an exaggeration to call it powerful!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Take just one lick, and your body will 
burn fiery red! Truly a hot bargain!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
T-To that extent...? Surely that's going a 
bit—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Of course, the taste is spot on too!

text_block_list.text:

drink, I took a bite of the ultra-spicy 
chorizo burger. ...Curiously enough, it 
almost tasted sweet."

special sauce, happily savoring the fiery 
spice...
